newsitem.title: USA: Orange County, Calif.,transit agency names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Orange County, Calif.,transit agency names new CEO.

text.p: The Orange County, Calif., Transportation Authority's board of directors on Monday voted to name Lisa Mills as the agency's new chief executive officer.
Mills replaces Stan Oftelie, who is leaving the authority to head the Orange County Business Council.
Mills will be the second CEO in the seven-year history of the transportation authority.
She has served as the agency's assistant CEO since 1993, and has worked with the authority and its predecessor agency, the Orange County Transportation Commission, since 1983.
As assistant CEO, Mills helped the authority respond to the Orange County bankruptcy. The authority had more than $1 billion invested in the failed Orange County investment pool.
The board of directors said it awarded Mills a two-year contract that pays $140,000 annually. She starts her new position on May 16.
